description: This Java class 'DataFile2EntityXml' is responsible for converting 'DataFile' objects into XML format. It includes methods to write data records into an XML entity file and a main method for command-line usage to generate XML files from data and definition files.

classes.name: DataFile2EntityXml
classes.description: A utility class for writing DataFile objects to XML entity files and executing as a standalone tool.

methods.name: writeToEntityXml
methods.description: Static method to serialize a DataFile into an XML file given a filename.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method for command-line execution to convert data and definition files into an XML output.

methods.name: writeToEntityXml
methods.description: Serializes a DataFile object into an XML format and writes to the specified file, handling special character encoding.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for command-line execution that reads data and definition files, processes them into XML, and writes to an output file.
